name: topaca-llm-cms
description: LLM-CMS Minimalvariante: Astro-Template + AGENTS.md + input/-Vertrauensgrenze + deterministische Validator-Diagnosen

scripts.preview: astro build && node scripts/check.mjs dist && astro preview
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.check:strict: astro sync && node scripts/check.mjs source --strict && node scripts/check.mjs dist --strict
scripts.check:release: npm run build && node scripts/check.mjs source --release && node scripts/check.mjs dist --release
